column4: EDC account stuck in LIMITED RELEASE/ PENDING
column5:
1. SO Data incomplete/incorrect:
'- Site Personnel Status is not ACTIVE
- EDC Submission Auth req. missing
- Site Status is not ACTIVATED, ENROLLING or END-ENROLL
- Study Status is not ACTIVE, APPROVED,  END ENROLL-CTRS or END ENROLL-PTS
- Study Stage is CLOSED
- Account release process has not happened yet since requirements were updated (process runs hourly)
2. NT account mismatch between SO and training log
column6:
1. Run EDC Account Status report, check EDC@ABBOTT.com mailbox for alert
2. If report states CSL did not complete Generic EDC training, but the CSL is present in the training log, compare the NT account in both tables (see below). If EMP_ID does not match NT_ACCT go into the training app and add the CSL manually
Select * from CAP.TRN_FORM_DETAIL 
WHERE TRN_MSTR_ID='3727' 
--and trn_dt > TO_DATE('25-DEC-2020','DD-MON-YYYY')
and upper(LAST_NAME) like 'VANDEN %'
order by EMP_ID, TRN_DT

Select DISTINCT NT_ACCT from CAP.SO_SJM_PERSONNEL
WHERE UPPER(LAST_NAME) LIKE 'VANDEN %'

Too many discrepancies/discrepancy records against a single CRF.  It only shows when trying to view the discrepancy details or discrepancy history, so loading the CRF is okay until viewing the discrepancy information.

column5:
A. Confirm correct Java version(s) installed
B. Needs to add sites to exception list

column6:
A. User should either have 1.8.0_191+, or both the older 1.8.0_45 AND 1.7. 
B. Add sites to exception list:
   1. Click on Start, type “configure java” in the search bar
   2. Click on the Configure Java returned result
   3. Click on the Security tab, Exception Site List, Edit Site List
   4. Add the following sites, one by one:
https://clinoas.sjm.com
https://clinoasdev.sjm.com
https://clinoastest.sjm.com
https://clinoc.sjm.com
https://clinoctest.sjm.com
https://clinocdev.sjm.com
   5. Clear Java cache
C. Delete the Deployment Rule set file
   1. Navigate to C:\Windows\Sun\Java\Deployment
   2. Delete the DeploymentRuleSet.jar file
   3. Open Edge and launch SO.
   4. When prompted, click checkboxes to accept risk and 'don't show' again, and Run with the Latest Version.
   5. Do the same for Oracle Clinical 5.2
   6. Issue should resolve.

column4: Blank screen when launching SO-New/SMA in Edge (or IE)
column5: Compatibility mode turned on
column6:
Click on the IE logo next to the address link to view the IE emulated version. It needs to be IE11 for SO New to launch successfully. If not IE 11 : 
-- If IE is still installed on the computer: Go to IE > Compatibility View settings. If any SJM.com exists in 'Websites you've added to Compatibility View', remove them. Also uncheck the Display intranet sites in Compatibility View, and close. Relaunch browser.
-- If IE is not installed anymore : Go into Edge’s settings (3 vertical dots) on the upper right-hand corner and go to Settings/Default Browser and ensure the setting for ‘Allow sites to be reloaded in Internet Explorer mode (IE mode) is set to ‘Allow’. Once that setting has been saved, you just need to reboot the machine and your changes should take effect and SO New should now launch in Edge.
--> If Compatibility version cannot be changed, contact DevOps

OR Workaround - new computers since Summer 2022 - must use Chrome because IE not allowed to be installed.
